value.title: Workflows, release, install
value.summary: Executor: ox (docker/CI domain). gh CLI authed for watching runs.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: "Order: gate -> release-please -> release builds -> installer -> dependabot -> docs."

value.title: CI gate workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml): on push to main; Linux runner; rust-toolchain.toml-pinned toolchain; pgvector service container (image per compose file); FS3_TEST_DATABASE_URL wired; fmt --check, clippy -D warnings, cargo test --workspace (plain - tiers keep endpoints/slow out), arch-drift; cargo cache. Prove green on a real push via gh run watch
release-please workflow + config: rust release type, semver from conventional commits, rolling release PR; document the merge-to-release flow in the README release section

Release build workflow (on release tag): linux arm64+x64 gnu+musl + windows x64 via the plan-002 build container (promote/reuse docker/ scripts); mac arm64+x64 native on a macos runner (build ONLY, never a gate); binaries attached to the Release named by target triple; deferred-validation stances in release notes template

install.sh (repo root or scripts/): OS/arch detect, fetch latest Release asset, install to a PATH dir with clear fallback messaging; install.ps1 twin (present, marked unvalidated); verify install.sh LIVE on this mac and in the linux build container
.github/dependabot.yml: cargo + github-actions ecosystems, sensible cadence; confirm first scan via gh api
README: release/install section (one-line install front and center, req 46) + CI badge; docs/services/ci-release.md per convention

tk-0101.assertion: gh run watch shows the gate green on a real main push; a deliberately-red probe branch run (or local act equivalent) proves it fails when tests fail

tk-0102.assertion: release PR appears after a feat/fix landing; merging it (Jordan's word) tags + publishes

tk-0103.assertion: a real Release carries all 7 assets; file(1) on each matches its triple

tk-0104.assertion: install.sh verified live on mac + linux container (binary runs --version); ps1 present with unvalidated banner

tk-0105.assertion: dependabot config accepted by GitHub (gh api) and first PRs/scan visible

tk-0106.assertion: README section + badge live; ci-release.md follows the services convention
